fields.description:
PROPOSED ROOT CAUSE (not yet implemented — needs plan-review before any code)

The operation-linked compaction sweep is not crash-atomic. rebar._commands.
compact_trigger.maybe_compact() fires on the tail of every ticket CLOSE and spawns a
DETACHED sweep worker (run_sweep -> compact.compact_all_cli -> compact_txn). The fold
performs snapshot-write -> retire (delete <id>/.archived) -> git commit as SEPARATE steps
with no rollback. If the detached worker dies, is killed, or races a concurrent writer
between the retire/delete and the commit, the SHARED tracker working tree is left DIRTY
with uncommitted changes: deletions of tracked <id>/.archived files and/or untracked
*-SNAPSHOT.json files.

A dirty tree then wedges the next reconverge. rebar._store.sync._union_merge runs
`git merge origin/tickets`, which git ABORTS. TWO abort variants:
 (a) untracked SNAPSHOT would be overwritten -> "untracked working tree files would be
     overwritten by merge" — recovered by Gerrit change 1757 / bug small-delicious-loris
     (6ccc-0577-198c-44fa).
 (b) tracked .archived deletions conflict -> "Your local changes to the following files
     would be overwritten by merge" — NOT handled by 1757.
The abort leaves auto-push unable to advance, so local ticket commits strand off origin ->
the P0 "changes not reaching origin / lost changes" symptom.

PROPOSED FIX (defense-in-depth):
 1. Make the fold crash-atomic so it never leaves a dirty tree: stage all snapshot writes +
    .archived retirements and commit them as ONE unit, with a try/finally cleanup that
    reverts a partial fold (git checkout -- . of tracked deletions + unlink of uncommitted
    SNAPSHOT temps) whenever the commit did not complete; or fold against a scratch
    index/worktree and swap in only on success.
 2. Add a crash-recovery preamble that, under the store write_lock at sweep start, detects
    and reverts a previously-abandoned partial fold before doing anything else.
 3. Pair with widening the reconverge recovery (loris/1757) to ALSO handle abort variant (b)
    (tracked-deletion), so both layers cover both variants.

INTERIM MITIGATION (operational, no code): set project config `compact.trigger = off` to
disable the operation-linked sweep (removes the dirty-tree seed); housekeeping then falls to
the scheduled compact-sweep workflow. NOTE: compact.trigger has NO env-var mapping — it is
project/user config only.
